## MKCinema 1.0

MKCinema now has its own app on every desktop and on Android, and the whole project is open source under GPL-3.0.

| Platform | File | Requirements |
|---|---|---|
| Android | `MKCinema.apk` | Android 7 or later |
| Windows | `MKCinema.exe` | Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit |
| macOS | `MKCinema-1.0.dmg` | macOS 11 or later |
| Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, Mint) | `mkcinema_1.0_amd64.deb` | WebKitGTK 4.1 |
| Linux (other) | `mkcinema-1.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | WebKitGTK 4.1 |

Every app opens the latest MKCinema in its own window, so new features arrive without a new download.

### First launch
- **Windows:** if SmartScreen appears, click **More info › Run anyway**.
- **Mac:** open the app once, then **System Settings › Privacy & Security › Open Anyway**.
- **Android:** allow your browser to install unknown apps when asked.

The Windows and Mac apps aren't code-signed by Microsoft or Apple yet.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/itbelikethatbruh/MKCinema/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for everything in the web app.
